Every tranche therefore offers at its own measured heat rate x measured delivered fuel + VOM. The only non-identity values in the dict sit on classes SPP has NO unit in (CC_INTERMEDIATE, CT_INTERMEDIATE, ST_GAS_INTERMEDIATE, COAL_PRB/BIT/LIGNITE/WC) and are provably inert. Structural shares (econ_low_share, pct_peaking) are generic and are not bands; per-plant committed / must-run / peaking shares come from thermal_tranches_SPP.csv (SPP-30, rule 23). Zero tuned scalars; authorized_price_tuning = NONE.
